```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
source('04_demand_forecast.R')
dataset <- load_sales_data('bikes_database.db')
selection <- dashboard_filters_server('filters', dataset)
applied <- selection$applied
selected_sales <- selection$sales
dark <- reactive(identical(input$view_mode, 'dark'))
forecast_result <- reactive({
  config <- applied()
  if (!config$forecast_mode) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(forecast_analysis(monthly_sales(selected_sales(), dataset$coverage, config$date_range),
                             config$horizon), error = identity)
})
comparison_result <- reactive(tryCatch(compare_periods(dataset, applied()), error = identity))
observeEvent(input$view_mode, {
  session$sendCustomMessage('dashboard-theme', if (dark()) 'dark' else 'light')
}, ignoreInit = FALSE)
output$validation_plot <- renderPlotly({
  result <- forecast_result(); req(!is.null(result), !inherits(result, 'error'))
  validation_plot(result, dark())
})
output$future_plot <- renderPlotly({
  result <- forecast_result(); req(!is.null(result), !inherits(result, 'error'))
  future_plot(result, dark())
})
output$forecast_metrics <- renderTable({
  result <- forecast_result(); req(!is.null(result), !inherits(result, 'error'))
  data.frame(Method = result$metrics$method,
    `MAE (USD/month)` = money(result$metrics$MAE, 2),
    `RMSE (USD/month)` = money(result$metrics$RMSE, 2), check.names = FALSE)
}, striped = FALSE, bordered = FALSE, spacing = 'm', width = '100%')
output$validation_values <- renderTable({
  result <- forecast_result(); req(!is.null(result), !inherits(result, 'error'))
  data.frame(Month = format(result$validation$date, '%Y-%m'),
    Actual = money(result$validation$actual, 2), Model = money(result$validation$model, 2),
    Baseline = money(result$validation$baseline, 2),
    Lower = money(result$validation$lower, 2), Upper = money(result$validation$upper, 2))
}, width = '100%')
output$category_drivers <- renderTable({
  result <- comparison_result(); req(!inherits(result, 'error'))
  data.frame(Category = result$categories$category, Status = result$categories$status,
    `Previous bikes` = result$categories$previous_quantity,
    `Current bikes` = result$categories$current_quantity,
    `Previous weighted price` = money(result$categories$previous_price, 2),
    `Current weighted price` = money(result$categories$current_price, 2),
    `Revenue change` = money(result$categories$revenue_change, 2), check.names = FALSE)
}, width = '100%')
```

```{js, echo=FALSE}
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('dashboard-theme', function(theme) {
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
});
```

### Applied selection

```{r scope, echo=FALSE}
renderUI({
  config <- applied(); metrics <- sales_kpis(selected_sales())
  types <- paste(config$category_1, collapse = ', ')
  families <- paste(config$category_2, collapse = ', ')
  shops <- if (length(config$shops) == length(unique(dataset$sales$bikeshop.name))) paste('All', length(unique(dataset$sales$bikeshop.name)), 'fictional stores') else paste(config$shops, collapse = ', ')
  tagList(
    tags$p(class = 'scope-text', sprintf('%s to %s. %s. %s. Families: %s. History unit: %s. %s',
      as.character(config$date_range[1]), as.character(config$date_range[2]), shops, types, families,
      config$time_unit, if (config$forecast_mode) paste('Monthly forecast horizon:', config$horizon, 'months.') else 'Forecast off.')),
    tags$p('Synthetic USD revenue. Forecast validation is monthly. This portfolio example does not support financial decisions.'),
    tags$div(class = 'kpi-group',
      tags$div(tags$h3('Revenue'), tags$p(class = 'kpi-value', money(metrics$revenue))),
      tags$div(tags$h3('Orders'), tags$p(class = 'kpi-value', format(metrics$orders, big.mark = ','))),
      tags$div(tags$h3('Bikes sold'), tags$p(class = 'kpi-value', format(metrics$bikes, big.mark = ','))),
      tags$div(tags$h3('Mountain / Road bikes'), tags$p(class = 'kpi-value', if (is.na(metrics$ratio)) 'Unavailable' else format(round(metrics$ratio, 2), nsmall = 2)),
        tags$p(metrics$ratio_note))),
    if (!nrow(selected_sales())) tags$p(role = 'status', 'No sales match this applied selection. Widen the date range or change the filters.')
  )
})
```

### Revenue by state

Hover over a state for its revenue. Darker blue means more selected revenue. Gray states have no selected sales. The map shows the contiguous U.S.

```{r map, echo=FALSE}
renderPlotly(state_revenue_plot(selected_sales(), dark()))
```

### Revenue over time

Descriptive totals use the applied historical chart unit. Partial boundary periods include only selected dates. These views have no forecast accuracy claim.

```{r historical, echo=FALSE}
renderPlotly({
  validate(need(nrow(selected_sales()) > 0, 'No sales in this selection. Change the filters and Apply.'))
  history_plot(aggregate_sales(selected_sales(), applied()$time_unit), dark())
})
```

Row {.content-row}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

### State totals

```{r state_table, echo=FALSE}
renderTable({
  sales <- selected_sales()
  if (!nrow(sales)) return(data.frame(State = character(), Revenue = character()))
  totals <- aggregate(sales$extended_price, list(State = sales$state), sum)
  totals <- totals[order(totals$x, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  data.frame(State = totals$State, `Revenue (USD)` = money(totals$x, 2), check.names = FALSE)
}, width = '100%')
```

### Monthly forecast and validation

```{r forecast, echo=FALSE}
renderUI({
  result <- forecast_result()
  if (is.null(result)) return(tags$p('Select Show monthly forecast and Apply. Evaluation requires at least 42 complete months.'))
  if (inherits(result, 'error')) return(tags$p(role = 'status', conditionMessage(result)))
  baseline_wins <- result$metrics$MAE[2] < result$metrics$MAE[1]
  tagList(
    tags$p(sprintf('Training: %s to %s. Heldout test: %s to %s (6 months).',
      format(result$train_start, '%Y-%m'), format(result$train_end, '%Y-%m'),
      format(result$test_start, '%Y-%m'), format(result$test_end, '%Y-%m'))),
    tags$p('Fixed regression of log(1 + monthly revenue) on time and month. The baseline repeats the same month from the previous year. The heldout months do not train either evaluation forecast.'),
    tags$p(paste('Applied stores:', paste(applied()$shops, collapse = ', '), '. Bike types:', paste(applied()$category_1, collapse = ', '), '. Families:', paste(applied()$category_2, collapse = ', '))),
    tags$h4('Heldout accuracy'),
    tableOutput('forecast_metrics'),
    tags$p(if (baseline_wins) 'The seasonal naive baseline has lower MAE for this selection.' else 'Compare both error measures. Results can differ by selection.'),
    tags$p('Synthetic data accuracy says nothing about real retail performance.'),
    plotlyOutput('validation_plot', height = '320px'),
    tags$details(tags$summary('Monthly validation values and 80% prediction bounds'), tableOutput('validation_values')),
    tags$h4('Future forecast after evaluation'),
    tags$p(sprintf('Refit on all selected complete history through %s. Future horizon: %d months. The dashed line marks the history boundary.',
      format(result$history_end, '%Y-%m'), applied()$horizon)),
    plotlyOutput('future_plot', height = '320px'),
    tags$p('Shading is a nominal 80% prediction range from the regression, not a smoothing band. It assumes independent, normally distributed residuals with constant variance on the log scale. The point is a back transformed median; negative bounds are limited to zero. Correlation, structural changes and model misspecification can reduce coverage.')
  )
})
```

### Period comparison

Added in this PR: compare the applied stores and categories with the immediately preceding period of equal length. The components describe revenue accounting. They do not prove causes.

```{r comparison, echo=FALSE}
renderUI({
  result <- comparison_result()
  if (inherits(result, 'error')) return(tags$p(role = 'status', conditionMessage(result)))
  current <- result$periods$current; previous <- result$periods$previous
  component_table <- tags$table(class = 'driver-table',
    tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th('Component', scope = 'col'), tags$th('Revenue change (USD)', scope = 'col'))),
    tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(result$components)), function(index) {
      tags$tr(tags$th(result$components$driver[index], scope = 'row'), tags$td(money(result$components$change[index], 2)))
    }), tags$tr(tags$th('Total observed change', scope = 'row'), tags$td(money(result$change, 2)))))
  tagList(
    tags$p(paste('Synthetic data. Applied stores:', paste(applied()$shops, collapse = ', '), '. Bike types:', paste(applied()$category_1, collapse = ', '), '. Families:', paste(applied()$category_2, collapse = ', '))),
    tags$p(sprintf('Current: %s to %s. Previous: %s to %s. Each period has %d days.', as.character(current[1]), as.character(current[2]), as.character(previous[1]), as.character(previous[2]), result$periods$days)),
    tags$p(sprintf('Revenue: %s previously, %s currently. Change: %s. Bikes: %s previously, %s currently.',
      money(result$previous_revenue, 2), money(result$current_revenue, 2), money(result$change, 2),
      format(result$previous_quantity, big.mark = ','), format(result$current_quantity, big.mark = ','))),
    tags$p(sprintf('Weighted unit price: %s previously, %s currently.',
      if (is.na(result$previous_weighted_price)) 'unavailable (no bikes)' else money(result$previous_weighted_price, 2),
      if (is.na(result$current_weighted_price)) 'unavailable (no bikes)' else money(result$current_weighted_price, 2))),
    component_table,
    tags$p('Volume changes total bikes at prior category shares and prices. Category mix changes those shares. Weighted price includes transaction price and product mix within a category. Components use full precision; displayed cents are rounded.'),
    tags$p('New categories use current price as their reference. Lost categories retain prior price. A zero prior total uses current shares; a zero current total uses prior shares. Both zero gives zero components.'),
    tags$details(tags$summary('Category quantities, weighted prices and changes'), tableOutput('category_drivers'))
  )
})
```
